semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact Oracle identity, name, mana cost, type, and the ordered Program Proliferate, sealed cohort choice, and PreviousEffectObjects PhaseOut shape.

The actual spell chooses an opponent for Poison and increments that player's counter, but players are absent from the second-choice domain; only current-controller receipt-bearing permanents are offered and a proper subset phases.
A completed zero-placement Proliferate produces a typed empty cohort and resolves without a second choice.
A nonempty second-choice domain has minimum zero; choosing none leaves the successful counter placement and phases no permanent.
Multiple counter kinds and doubled placement still produce one receipt-bound candidate, with counters unchanged by the later phase choice.
The actual second choice can select all receipt-bearing candidates across a noncreature artifact, land, and planeswalker, preserving each counter total.
Two actual Doubling Seasons suspend a Proliferate placement for replacement ordering; the resumed placement completes once, binds its receipt, then phases the chosen recipient.
Counter prevention that reduces placement to zero creates no receipt and no permanent choice.
Duplicate, foreign-controller, nonreceipt, and stale-incarnation answers are rejected without changing state or generation captures.
An independently selected attachment phases out directly and returns only to its exact saved recipient incarnation.
A selected parent and attachment phase as an indirect attachment cohort regardless of selection order, preserving counters and generations.
A departed spell controller receives no delegated second-choice menu and completes the begun resolution with an empty selected cohort.
A departed physical spell owner removes exact owned candidates and the source object while the surviving controller receives a fresh narrowed choice and completes the begun spell once.
